text: Stone Energy has successfully plugged and abandoned the VR 255 OCS G-01152 which was damaged by Hurricane Rita.  Operations began on July 3, 2007 and were completed on August 9, 2007.  This well site is an approved rigs to reefs site.  Casings have been cut at 63' AML.

Due to confirmed loss of control line integrity, Stone Energy has successfully locked open the SCSSV and installed a PB style SSCSV. Upon submittal of the leakage rate, approval was granted to flow the well.

This portion of work was to decomplete the well, as approved under the temporary abandonment APM. The attached schematic shows the current plugs in place. Plans are to finish the temporary abandonment operations approximately mid to late April 2013. (An RPM will be filed to denote what portion of the previously approved procedure was completed, and what remains.)

A coil tubing unit was previoulsy mobilized in late 2012 and all three zones were squeezed and cement left in the tubing.

Stone has successfully completed workover operations on the VK 989 Well A010 to clean out well and set a through-tubing screen. Operations were completed by utilizing a coil tubing unit to reduce sand production.  Operations began 11/22/2012 and ended 11/28/2012.

Due to the fact that this well was classified as P&A?d by a previous operator in 1992 when the well was actually TA?d, McMoRan cannot change the P&A date to truly reflect the correct P&A date.  The B010 well was actually P&A?d (all casings removed 16-ft BML) on 08/05/2010.

The HI A-494 Well B-4(BP02) was drilled w/ the MODU, Diamond Ocean King. The well was spud on 08-25-13 and drilled to a TD of 14,790' MD / 14,509' TVD w/ a MW of 14.5 ppg at 15:30 hrs on 09-02-13.

While performing drilling operations to clean out the wellbore to set the 5" production liner, Rooster inadvertently wobbled out of hole and the BP02 wellbore collapsed at 14,264' MD / 13,941' TVD.

Attempt to return well to production was unsuccessful.  Well produced 100% water after installation of a pack-off across a tubing leak.  The pack-off was pulled and a DX plug reset in the well.  Configuration of the wellbore has not changed.

Stone has successfully performed zone change operations on the WC 56 OCS 00301, Well No. 16 to produce the Discorbis "B-1" Sd.  Operations began on February 24, 2008 and were completed on March 2, 2008.  The previous producing interval in the well, the Discorbis "B-2" Sand was isolated by setting a TTVP @ 9110' and dumping 20' cement on top, ETOC @ 9090'.  The Discorbis "B-1" Sand was perforated @ 9006' - 9016'.

Operations were completed on the MC 28 Well TB-3(BP04) to replace the failed CCV in bore 1.  During the job, communication to the SCSSV in bore 2 was reestablished so the valve was not locked open as previously planned. Operations started 04/30/2012 and ended 06/30/2012.

Operations to temporarily abandon the well through the surface plug were completed on 07/25/2025.

eWell recognizes a TA date of 09/16/2006 due to previous zonal isolation operations & prevents updating the date. This operation was to complete full TA through the surface plug.

1.	Mobilized liftboat with slickline equipment to the MP 64 No. 3 single well caisson on August 28, 2016.
2.	Held safety meeting and discussed everyone's role during project.
3.	Rigged up 5K slickline lubricator system and tested to 1500 psig.
4.	Made a 2.25" gauge run to top of MRBP at 7,363' ELM.  POOH.
5.	TIH with tubing end locator and located the EOT at 7,177' ELM.
6.	Continued in hole and tagged bottom at 7,363'.  Confirmed no fill on top of MRBP.  POOH.
7.	Rigged up 2" dump bailer and made two runs, dump bailed cement on top of MRBP to 7,350'.  POOH.  
8.	Rigged down slickline equipment and demobilized liftboat.
9.	WOC.

An uphole re-complete was performed to isolate the M55 reservoir, recover the existing upper completion, add perforations and a frac pack in the M57 interval, and install a new upper completion.  The well will be produced from the M57 and the M55 will remain isolated below a mechanical plug per the approved permit.

Arena initially intended to TA this wellbore. However, operations were suspended due to slight bubbling
from the 10-3/4" x 7-5/8" annulus which slowly dissipated while showing 0 psi on the annulus pressure gauge.

Arena obtained approval to set a CIBP in the 7-5/8" casing at 490' MD, test to 1,000 psi and suspend operations to allow time to monitor the 10-3/4" x 7-5/8" casing annulus and leave space inside the 7-5/8" casing for further remediation of possible sustained casing pressure or install a surface cement plug after a successful bubble test is achieved at a later date.

Permanently Abandoned.  Previously cut 26", 16" & 10-3/4" @ 15'BML 03/16/2000, were pulled 06/26/2024.

(Please note: Upon further investigation we found that the well was previously cut 03/16/2000 by CNG Producing as follows: 26", 16" & 10-3/4" mechanically cut @ 15'BML - see attached corresponding WAR)

The GC 826-10 ST02BP00 wellbore was drilled to TD and the 9-7/8in liner was run and cemented to isolate the reservoir sands. The tieback casing was installed, and the well was then completed (initial completion).

Stone has successfully completed zone change operations on the SS 99 A1ST1 well to produce the "R-1" sd. The previous completion, the "S-1" sd, was isolated by setting a TTVBP @ 12,700' MD  and dumping 54' of cmt on top of TTVBP, w/ ETOC @ 12,646' MD. The "R-1" sd was then exposed to production by perforating the intervals of 12,342'-12,366' MD. Operations began on 09/18/2010 and were completed on 09/23/2010.

This EOR is being submitted to show that all remaining casing stings in this well were cut at 20' below the mud line and pulled out of hole 01/19/2011. E-well will not allow me to change the well status date because the well status is not changing(well was already in P&A status).

Slight intermittent bubbles were observed emanating from the annuli.   A slip on intervention well cap was installed. Micro-Matrix Cement was injected to stop bubbling. No bubbles observed.

Please note: The 20", 13 3/8", 9 5/8" and 7" casings / conductors were cut at 179' AML.

Pre-temporary abandonment operations utilizing coil tubing to set cement plug. Final temporary abandonment operations will be conducted with a platform rig in early 2012. The well will have no future utility.

Stone Energy successfully performed zone change operations to produce the "C-1" Sand in SS 98, Well #2BP1.  Operations began on August 16, 2009 and ended on August 29, 2009.  The previous producing interval, the "D-2" Sand, was isolated by setting a MRBP @ 12350' MD and dumping 50' of cmt on top of the plug, ETOC @ 12300' MD.  The "C-1" Sand was then perforated from 9409' to 9413' MD.
